I understand you want to be certain you’ve got options if something doesn’t work out. Here’s what we can do for you.
Returns
Return for a refund if you’re not 100% satisfied, provided it’s within 14 days of receipt and the item is as new, unworn and unwashed.
Once the return is initiated, the item must be sent back to us within one month of the request.
Refunds are processed within 14 days of the warehouse receiving and inspecting the return and are credited to the original payment method; it can take up to five working days to appear in your account.
Return shipping is free for the majority of regions via our Returns Portal. In some markets a flat return fee of £5 (or local equivalent) is deducted from the refund — the portal will show this clearly before you confirm.
Classics Guarantee (30-day)
Eligible Classic products have a 30-day guarantee: if you’re not happy within 30 days of riding them, return for a full refund or credit.
Limited to four products per customer per calendar year. Items must be returned within 30 days of purchase. (This applies only to the listed Classic items.)
Repairs and Faults
We offer a free repair service for the lifetime of the product with valid proof of purchase. This covers most jerseys, bibs, jackets, vests, tights and warmers and some manufacturing faults.
Some items can’t be mended (for example: base layers, t‑shirts, socks and certain Merino items). A well‑worn or end‑of‑life item may also be past repair.
Allow up to four weeks from the point our repairs team receives your item.
You cover shipping the item to us; we return repaired items to you free of charge on our standard service.
If you suspect a manufacturing fault, we’ll assess it before you return the item so we can confirm next steps.
Exchanges and bundles
We don’t offer direct exchanges for online orders. If you want a different size or product, place a new order and return the unwanted item for a refund.
When all items from a bundle are returned, a full refund is issued (less any applicable return fee). If returning part of a bundle, we can discuss price adjustments if needed.
Other important points
We reserve the right to refuse refunds for returned items not in saleable condition.
For gift returns, the original purchaser must initiate the return due to privacy regulations.
If you want me to look up your specific order or check eligibility for a return or repair, may I please have your order number? It should start with the letter 'C'.
If you’d like, I can connect you to someone from our Customer Care team for further assistance.
